hero.heading: Built on Planning.
hero.intro: A construction company working from Osogbo, Osun State — delivering building construction, luxury residential homes, structural works and project supervision for clients who want the work done properly the first time.

paragraphs: Construction goes wrong in predictable ways: a scope that was never fully agreed, materials chosen at the last minute, changes that arrive after the concrete has set. Our approach is built around removing those gaps.

We start with the brief and the site. We agree what is included, in what order it will be built, and the standard it will be finished to. Then we build it in defined stages, with one team responsible for the work from start to finish and with progress reported as it happens.

TOC Luxury Constructions Ltd operates from USTEEM Junction, Agunbelewo, Osogbo. Clients come to us with a plot and an idea, with drawings ready for construction, or with work in progress that needs proper supervision. In each case the question is the same: what does it take to deliver this properly?

principles.title: Plan before you build
principles.body: Scope, sequence and materials are settled before work starts. On a construction site the cheapest corrections happen on paper, not in concrete.

principles.title: Build to the drawings
principles.body: Work follows the drawings and specifications issued for the project, and the engineering input that accompanies them. Where something does not work on site, it comes back as a question before it becomes a change.

principles.title: Report honestly
principles.body: Progress, material choices and anything that affects cost or programme are raised as they arise — while there is still time to make a decision.

about.mission: To deliver construction work that clients can rely on: properly planned, honestly reported, and finished to the standard that was agreed.
about.vision: To be the construction partner that clients in Osogbo and across Osun State return to, and recommend, because the work stands up.

preview.heading: Built on Planning.
paragraphs: TOC Luxury Constructions Ltd is a construction company based at USTEEM Junction, Agunbelewo, in Osogbo, Osun State. We build for clients who want the work done properly — planned before it starts, supervised while it runs, and finished to the standard that was agreed.

The approach is straightforward: understand the brief, agree the scope in writing, execute in defined stages, and report honestly at every stage. Structure, materials and finishing are treated as one continuous decision rather than three separate ones.

services.heading: Four ways we
services.intro: Each service is delivered as a defined scope with agreed stages, so you always know what is being done, what it costs and what comes next.
services.notice: These descriptions are written for review. TOC will confirm the exact scope of each service before launch, including any specialist capability, registration or certification the company holds and wishes to publish.

items.title: Building Construction
items.tagline: Complete building works, coordinated from first activity on site to the final finish.
items.summary: Complete building works, coordinated from the first site activity through to the final finish.
body: We build from approved drawings and specifications, coordinating the sequence of work on site — setting out and foundation works, the structural frame and blockwork, roofing, services first-fix, plastering and floor and wall finishes, joinery, and the external works that complete a building.

One site team stays responsible for the work from start to finish. Progress, materials and anything that affects cost or programme are reported as they arise, so decisions are made on current information rather than assumption.
scope: Site setting out and foundation works
Coordination of plumbing and electrical services with your appointed trades
Plastering, tiling, painting and general finishing

image.alt: Steel reinforcement and formwork on a building structure under construction, used as reference imagery

items.title: Luxury Residential Homes
items.tagline: Homes built around how you live — good layouts, honest materials, durable finishes.
items.summary: Homes built around how you actually live — considered layouts, honest materials, finishes that hold up.
body: A house is decided long before the finishing stage: in how rooms are oriented, how living spaces relate to each other, where light and air move through the plan, storage that disappears into the walls, and materials chosen for how they age rather than how they photograph.

We build private homes from your brief and the drawings prepared for your project, advising on buildable details, material selection and finishing standards at each stage — and finishing the house to the standard it was designed for.
scope: Layout, material and finishing review before work begins
Premium finishes — plaster, tiling, paint and joinery
Kitchen, wardrobe and bespoke joinery work

image.alt: Modern residence with a timber soffit and pool terrace, used as reference imagery

items.title: Civil Engineering & Structural Works
items.tagline: Reinforced concrete and structural packages, built accurately to the issued drawings.
items.summary: Reinforced concrete and structural packages executed accurately to the drawings and engineering input issued for each project.
body: We carry out structural and civil works packages: setting out, excavation and earthworks, reinforcement fixing, formwork, concrete placement and curing, columns, beams, slabs and retaining structures, drainage and external hardworks.

Work follows the drawings and specifications issued for the project. Structural design and engineering certification are provided by the design professionals appointed to each project — we build to their instructions, and the work is checked and recorded as it progresses.
scope: Columns, beams, slabs and retaining structures

image.alt: Ground slab and structural works in progress with a site team, used as reference imagery

items.title: Project Supervision & Consultancy
items.tagline: A competent presence on your behalf: oversight, progress checks and clear reporting.
items.summary: An informed, competent presence on site — progress, workmanship, materials and clear reporting for owners.
body: Not every client needs a contractor. Some need someone competent to stand on their behalf. We supervise and coordinate building work: checking that it follows the approved drawings and specification, monitoring workmanship and material quality, tracking progress against programme, and reporting to the owner in plain language.

Engagements are scoped to what is genuinely required — a periodic site visit with a written report, full supervision of a package of works, or an independent view before you commit to a contractor, a material order or a purchase.
scope: Review of drawings, scope and specification
Advice on variations and next steps

process.heading: What happens after you
process.intro: Four stages, in plain language, so you know what to expect and what we need from you at each point.
process.notice: These four stages describe how enquiries are handled in draft form. TOC will confirm and adjust them to match the company's actual procedures before launch.

stages.title: Consultation
stages.description: We start with a conversation about the site, the scope and what you are trying to achieve. Bring drawings if you have them; if you do not, we will tell you exactly what information is needed to move forward.
stages.outcome: A clear understanding of scope, and the information still required

stages.title: Planning
stages.description: The scope of work is confirmed together with the sequence of activities, materials and finishing standards, and the basis of the quotation. Site conditions are confirmed with a visit where required.

stages.title: Execution
stages.description: Work proceeds in defined stages once the scope is agreed. You receive progress updates as the work moves, and any change that affects cost or programme is raised with you before it is carried out.
stages.outcome: Staged, supervised construction work with progress reporting

stages.title: Review & Handover
stages.description: Completed work is reviewed against the agreed scope and specification, outstanding items are listed and closed out, and the project is handed over with the agreed documentation.
stages.outcome: A documented review, close-out of outstanding items and handover

reviews.heading: What clients say,
reviews.intro: We publish the rating that appears on the company’s own Google Maps business listing, with the source named. We do not reproduce individual review text here until each quotation has been verified against the live review and its attribution is appropriate.

rating.note: Rating and review count as published on the company’s Google Maps listing. This figure is a written record, not a live feed, and is updated when the listing is reviewed.

items.question: What information do you need to prepare a quotation?
items.answer: Useful starting points are the site location, the type of project, any drawings or plans you already have, and the level of finish you have in mind. If you do not have drawings yet, tell us what you want to build and where — we will explain what is needed next. You can send details through the inquiry form or directly on WhatsApp.

items.question: How do I start a construction project with TOC?
items.answer: Send an inquiry or request a consultation. We will discuss the site, scope and budget direction, then confirm what happens next. Nothing becomes a commitment until the scope and quotation have been agreed in writing.

items.question: Do you work outside Osogbo?
items.answer: Our office is at USTEEM Junction, Agunbelewo, Osogbo, Osun State. Projects further afield are considered case by case — contact us with the location and scope and we will confirm whether we can take the work on.

items.question: Can I send drawings or photographs with my inquiry?
items.answer: Yes. Secure upload can be enabled on the inquiry form once a storage endpoint is configured for it. In the meantime, the quickest route is to submit the form and continue the conversation on WhatsApp, where you can attach plans and photographs directly.

items.question: Can I book a consultation online?
items.answer: You can send a consultation request with your preferred date and time band. This is a request, not a confirmed appointment: we review it and confirm an actual time with you by phone or WhatsApp.

items.question: Are the projects in the gallery TOC projects?
items.answer: Not yet. The portfolio is being prepared and currently uses licensed reference photography as layout placeholders — no company project name, location, date or value is published until it has been verified with TOC.

privacy.heading: Privacy
privacy.intro: This page explains what happens to the information you enter on this website, and what does not happen to it. It is written to match how the site is actually built.

sections.heading: Cookies, analytics and advertising
paragraphs: This website sets no tracking or advertising cookies and runs no analytics scripts. There is no profiling, no remarketing pixel and no third-party tag manager.
We do not sell, rent or share your information with anyone for marketing purposes.

sections.heading: Information you provide
paragraphs: The inquiry form collects your name, phone number, email address (optional), the service and project type you select, the project location, an optional budget range, an optional preferred consultation date, and your project description. The consultation form collects your name, contact details, the service of interest, a preferred date and time band, the project location and optional notes.
Please do not include sensitive personal information in the free-text fields. If you would rather not use the forms at all, you can reach us by phone or WhatsApp.

sections.heading: Signing in to the admin area
paragraphs: The administration area is for TOC staff only. Signing in sets a single essential cookie that keeps the session active; it contains no personal information and no tracking identifiers. Login attempts are rate-limited, and the session cookie is sent only over a secure connection when the site is served over HTTPS.

sections.heading: Attachments
paragraphs: If you send drawings or photographs, please share only what is necessary for the assessment — for example a plan or a site photograph rather than full legal documents.

sections.heading: WhatsApp, maps and third parties
paragraphs: Buttons and links labelled WhatsApp open wa.me with a pre-filled message. Once you send it, the conversation is hosted by WhatsApp (Meta) and is governed by their privacy terms — TOC no longer controls that data. Nothing is sent automatically.

The map on the contact page loads from OpenStreetMap only after you press "Load the map". Until then, no request is made to that provider. Links out to Google Maps open Google’s own site and are subject to Google’s terms.

sections.heading: How long information is kept
paragraphs: Project enquiries and consultation requests are kept by {{company}} for as long as needed to respond to you and to manage any resulting project or quotation. You can ask for your details to be deleted at any time by calling {{phone}}.

sections.heading: Your choices
paragraphs: You can contact the company without using this website at all, by calling {{phone}} or sending a message on WhatsApp. You can ask what information the company holds about you and ask for corrections or deletion.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: If the way this site handles information changes — for example when a new integration is connected — this page will be updated before that change goes live.

privacy.note: This policy describes the site as built. Please review and approve it (or supply your own) before launch, and update it whenever new integrations are connected.
